title: PhysStream: Streaming Physics-Grounded Video Generation with Structured Scene Memory and Fine-Grained Motion Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.17521v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive control for video generation is moving from coarse prompts toward fine-grained, physically meaningful manipulation of dynamic scenes. Yet existing controllable methods either require the full control schedule before generation starts, or use pixel-space signals that dictate object positions rather than physical dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose PhysStream, an autoregressive model for physics-grounded image-to-video synthesis that incorporates structured scene memory---positional maps and object tracking maps derived online from previously generated frames---and supports fine-grained motion control via sparse velocity-increment signals that encode physical quantities, letting the model learn the underlying dynamics. We train our model in two stages: a bidirectional model is first finetuned with motion-control conditioning, then a causal autoregressive model is trained with additional structured scene memory,

translated_title: PhysStream：基于结构化场景记忆与细粒度运动控制的流式物理感知视频生成
translated_abstract: 交互式视频生成控制正从粗糙的提示词向细粒度的、具有物理意义的动态场景操控发展。然而，现有的可控方法要么需要在生成开始前提供完整的控制计划，要么使用像素空间信号来直接规定物体位置而非物理动态。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了PhysStream，一个用于物理感知图像到视频合成的自回归模型。该模型引入了结构化场景记忆——即从先前生成的帧中在线提取的位置图和物体跟踪图——并通过编码物理量的稀疏速度增量信号支持细粒度运动控制，让模型学习潜在的动力学规律。我们采用两阶段方式训练模型：首先在运动控制条件下微调双向模型，随后结合额外的结构化场景记忆训练因果自回归模型。
tldr: PhysStream提出了一种基于物理的自回归图像到视频生成模型，通过从已生成帧在线提取的结构化场景记忆和编码物理量的稀疏速度增量信号，实现了细粒度的运动控制。
en_tdlr: PhysStream introduces an autoregressive physics-grounded image-to-video generation model that achieves fine-grained motion control via structured scene memory derived online from generated frames and sparse velocity-increment signals encoding physical quantities.
